battle_phases.completion_condition: Opening outer hostiles are killed, #3 and #4 are destroyed, and reciprocal medicine is established.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An unfinished eastern restraint or surviving opening hostile breaks civilian protection or an outer interception gap.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four independent interceptions and open the eastern civilian restraints.
handoff_requirements: Melantha's second-70 withdrawal leaves no unresolved opening upper hostile.
Midnight's withdrawal starts the exact seventy-second cooldown for his second-155 return.
responsibilities: Fang and Vanilla share central attacks.
Melantha clears #3 while intercepting upper traffic.
Midnight clears #4 while intercepting lower traffic.
Gallus works on #1 without targeting civilians.
battle_phases.start_condition: Stage begins with 10 DP and no deployed operators.
survival_dependencies: Vanguards must survive their first terrors and officers to earn the declared DP.
Outer opening units receive no assumed medical coverage.
Midnight must finish #4 before his second-85 withdrawal.

battle_phases.completion_condition: An ENEMY_DEATH event confirms artillery destruction before frame 4800.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Surviving artillery invalidates the medical and outer-survival assumptions of every subsequent phase.
battle_phases.goal: Kill the artillery through sustained eastern coverage while preserving the medical sources.
handoff_requirements: Lava leaves at 135 only after delivering her declared window.
Steward's second-160 withdrawal requires a completed kill; it does not transfer artillery duty to Durin.
responsibilities: Steward attacks across both column-7 stops and transfers.
Lava adds lower arts and a supported attack-speed window.
Both medics cover both casters; Lancet bridges the approach.
Beagle and Cardigan establish outer containment before later officers arrive.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward deploys at second 70 and the artillery approaches its eastern route.
survival_dependencies: Lancet's second-80 global heal must occur while Ansel is alive.
Both full medics must survive and perform their enhancements.
Actual artillery hits must cover the complete 13000 HP debt despite competing targets.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Midnight, Spot and Durin hold their final central responsibilities and Midnight becomes skill-ready at second 195.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An overwhelmed rear catcher or absent lower arts source allows the late terror and armor queues to outrun blocking.
battle_phases.goal: Replace the economic opening with separated upper and lower clearance and sufficient overflow capacity.
handoff_requirements: Upper rear interception exists before Fang leaves.
Each vacated central tile is occupied again within the same scheduled frame.
responsibilities: Noir Corne catches upper overflow behind [3,5].
Midnight replaces Fang at 155 facing DOWN.
Spot replaces Vanilla at 155 with three-block lower containment.
Durin begins lower-only arts at 160.
battle_phases.start_condition: Noir Corne establishes upper rear interception at second 135.
survival_dependencies: Both medics cover Midnight, Spot and Durin.
Noir Corne has no assumed healing: one full-health terror costs approximately 1300-1365 HP during his ordinary kill, below his 1670 HP; extra rear arrivals require separate accounting.
No unearned vanguard DP is credited after a source death.

battle_phases.completion_condition: The upper rear queue is empty and returning Steward joins at second 240.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A missing clearance source can fill blocking capacity even when defenders remain alive; later deployments cannot erase a leak.
battle_phases.goal: Clear central armor and terrors while preserving outer officer interception.
handoff_requirements: Noir Corne's caught enemies must be dead before his second-240 retirement.
Steward returns after more than his required seventy-second cooldown and inherits both central damage ranges.
responsibilities: Upper Midnight cannot divert attacks into the lower lane.
Lower Durin cannot divert attacks into the upper lane.
Spot holds up to three lower enemies while ordinary attacks and Durin clear a slot.
Beagle and Cardigan retain their outer queues.
battle_phases.start_condition: Midnight activates upper arts at second 195.
survival_dependencies: At 20 RES Midnight's active ordinary hit is 536.76; at 50 RES it is 335.475, with a 1.3-second interval.

A full upper armor target takes about 19.4 seconds of Midnight arts before existing physical damage; a terror takes about 8.5 seconds. Either first kill releases capacity before the next upper armor approaches.
Lower Durin supplies 106.25 DPS against armor or 170 DPS against terrors, alongside Spot's ordinary attacks.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both expected protected targets have reached their objectives, no protected target has died, zero enemies have leaked, remaining_life is positive and no active enemies remain.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A detained, dead or missing protected target fails project acceptance even if hostile clearance otherwise succeeds.
battle_phases.goal: Release the second civilian after officer clearance and finish with both objectives intact.
handoff_requirements: Beagle's slot transfers to Melantha after its hostile responsibility ends.
Count each protected arrival explicitly; roadblock destruction alone is insufficient.
responsibilities: Keep Cardigan east of the civilian detained at roadblock #2.
Retire Beagle at 280 only after the upper outer queue has cleared.
Melantha destroys #2 from [6,3] LEFT.
Maintain central medicine and arts through final clearance.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward has restored terminal central arts and all scheduled hostile spawns have occurred.
survival_dependencies: Cardigan's lower outer interception must survive every queued officer.
No artillery remains to threaten a delayed protected target.
Melantha must complete #2 before withdrawing at 310.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward and Lava must deliver the complete artillery kill before Steward's second-160 withdrawal. Deployment time alone earns no damage credit.
Melantha clears #3; Gallus clears #1; Beagle intercepts subsequent upper outer officers. Confirm the first protected arrival independently.
Opening Midnight clears #4 before the civilian spawns. Cardigan intercepts officers east of the civilian detained at #2. Melantha releases #2 after outer clearance.
Fang hands upper central interception to Midnight. Noir Corne catches overflow; Midnight's DOWN-facing arts and later Steward clear the queue.
Vanilla hands lower interception to Spot. Durin's RIGHT-facing range supplies continuous, geographically separated lower clearance.
Melantha handles the opening; Beagle handles all later upper outer officers before his retirement.
Opening Midnight handles the initial pair; Cardigan handles every later lower outer officer.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Opening upper interception and reciprocal central attacks.
Opening lower interception and reciprocal central attacks.
Opening upper outer interception and roadblock #3 clearance.
Opening lower outer interception and roadblock #4 clearance.
Lower medical anchor; cover both eastern casters, both central interception tiles and Hibiscus.
Upper medical anchor with reciprocal caster, blocker and Ansel coverage.
Primary artillery attacker; forward tip includes [5,7].
Deployment heal and temporary treatment of Ansel and opening lower units.
Lower eastern artillery damage; count individual arts hits only.
Permanent upper outer interception until its final queue is cleared.
Permanent lower outer interception, separating officers from the western civilian restraint.
Temporary three-block upper overflow interception behind Midnight.
Upper central interception and arts clearance; facing excludes the lower central blocking tile.
Three-block lower central containment; ordinary attacks only.
Continuous lower central arts; facing excludes upper row 3.
Terminal arts covering both central interception tiles.
Late, uncontested roadblock #2 clearance after outer officer clearance.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward's [2,7] UP range contains the entire column-7 vertical segment, including its lower endpoint. Lava [5,7] DOWN covers the lower eastern segment. Medics at [2,6] UP and [5,6] DOWN both cover the casters, each other and central column-5 blockers.
formation_structure.central: Midnight [3,5] DOWN owns upper clearance; Spot [4,5] owns lower three-block containment; Durin [5,5] RIGHT supplies lower-only arts. Noir Corne [3,4] catches upper overflow during Midnight's charging interval.
formation_structure.medical_bridge: Lancet arrives at second 80 for the supported 200 global heal and additional lower treatment. She remains until second 119, when Cardigan requires her deployment slot.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla attack across their adjacent central rows. Melantha and Midnight independently intercept the outer streams while clearing eastern roadblocks.
formation_structure.terminal: Steward replaces Noir Corne after the rear queue clears. Beagle later yields his slot to Melantha for the final civilian release. Cardigan remains until the lower outer queue is empty.

formation_transitions.transition: Melantha withdraws after upper opening clearance; Steward takes the released deployment slot.
Lancet adds immediate global recovery before the previously observed medical collapse.
Opening Midnight withdraws after roadblock #4 clearance; his cooldown supports the upper central handoff at second 155.
Lava occupies the lower eastern firing tile while both medics and Lancet are present.
Gallus withdraws after roadblock #1 clearance, releasing the slot for Beagle.
Lancet withdraws; Cardigan takes over lower outer interception before the first paired officers arrive.
Lava withdraws after her enhanced lower firing window; Noir Corne establishes upper rear interception.
Fang yields [3,5] to Midnight and Vanilla yields [4,5] to Spot. Noir Corne already protects the upper handoff.
Steward withdraws after the required artillery kill; fresh Durin establishes continuous lower central arts.
After the upper rear queue clears, Noir Corne yields his slot to returning Steward.
After the upper outer queue clears, Beagle yields his slot to Melantha for roadblock #2 clearance.
Melantha withdraws after roadblock #2 destruction; retain the remaining formation until both protected arrivals and complete hostile clearance.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator has catalog identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode true. Deploy only on legal terrain; never on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Never exceed eight deployed operators. Every replacement withdraws its predecessor first.
Acceptance requires remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, zero protected-target deaths, exhausted spawns, no active enemies and exactly two safe protected arrivals. Operator deaths are recorded separately.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Protection comes from roadblock management and hostile interception.
Artillery must be dead before frame 4800. Durin inherits a clearance slot, not unresolved artillery damage. Absence of the kill invalidates this handoff.
Both medics must remain alive through the eastern firing windows. Lancet's supported deployment heal and treatment are survival dependencies, not assumed DP repairs.
Roadblock #4 must be destroyed before the second civilian's approach. Preserve #2 until late release; Cardigan must intercept every officer east of its detained civilian.
Noir Corne must retain capacity for upper overflow and survive until its queue is empty. His retirement cannot be credited if a caught enemy remains.
Midnight [3,5] DOWN excludes [4,5]; Durin [5,5] RIGHT excludes [3,5]. Preserve these directions to prevent cross-lane damage diversion.
Use natural DP and only earned vanguard activations; count no retreat refunds. Any source-operator death invalidates its later income and dependent deployment ledger.
No probability talent is required. Do not assume client target priority, splash geometry or ordinary-WALK roadblock navigation.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish four interceptions, clear the upper eastern restraint, build reciprocal medicine and preserve both vanguards through the artillery approach.
Accumulate artillery damage through Steward's full column-7 coverage; Lancet bridges medical exposure; establish Lava and permanent outer interception.
Finish the artillery, complete Lava's enhanced lower window, install upper rear interception and execute both central replacements.
Durin clears lower targets continuously. Upper Midnight charges while Noir Corne catches the additional upper terror. Both medics sustain the central formation.
Midnight uses arts on the upper queue while Durin independently clears the lower queue. Retire Noir Corne only after his caught enemies die.
Steward completes central clearance. Confirm upper outer clearance before Beagle leaves, then destroy the final civilian roadblock.
Keep medicine and blocking active until both civilians reach their objectives and every hostile queue is empty.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP at seconds 19,44,69,94,119,144 only while alive and deployed.
Manual DP and ATK at 25,55,85,115,145; each ten-second active interval pauses time-SP.
Opening ATK enhancement at 60. The late roadblock assignment requires ordinary attacks only.
Opening arts at 70. Redeployment at 155 resets readiness: upper arts at 195,305,415; forty active seconds precede seventy charging seconds.
Healing enhancement at 69,129,189,249,309,369,429. Exclude probabilistic extra-target healing.
Healing enhancement at 88,138,188,238,288,338,388,438. Exclude unsupported passive ATK.
Deployment at 94 plus supported deployment SP permits readiness at 104. Activate at 115 through the final lower firing window; exclude splash damage.
DEF enhancement at 153,223,293 would follow the seventy-second cycle; omit the second-293 activation because retirement is at 280.
Use supported automatic enhanced attacks. Count actual artillery recipients; exclude highest-DEF targeting and passive ATK.
Use ordinary attacks and blocking only. No unsupported guardian healing, self-healing, defensive talents, RES reduction or evasion.

tactical_thesis: Concentrate eastern artillery damage through Steward's three-tile forward tip at [2,7] UP, supported by two medics in column 6. Lancet bridges the exposed medical approach before Lava takes the lower firing position. After artillery clearance, separate central damage geometrically: Midnight faces DOWN on the upper interception tile; Durin faces RIGHT from the lower high ground. Noir Corne supplies temporary upper overflow capacity. Keep the second civilian behind its western roadblock until officer clearance permits an uncontested release.
